_about: Chapter D (Determinism) of the suite results document: the prose data of DESIGN-DOC.md section 5 in R.json's format, written for the union of manifest v4 and v5 (the chapter's 21 scenarios, 1 family and 6 units are the same in both; v5's twins carry their sources' v5 requests and expectations, e.g. D-R-junction-0003's header runs, and property-level marks for the checks the tools do not expose). `summary` and `coverage_gap` lead the chapter page, `intro` follows the computed lines; `families` keys on the family id, `units` on the unit id. Every figure of the run is a placeholder (doc/facts.py) and every run-dependent sentence a conditional. The literal numbers are constants of the SPEC and of the manifest, listed under `_assumes`. Every claim follows SPEC-labeled-traversal-core.md section 6.8, SPEC-pattern-search.md section 7.9, areas.py gen_D, checks.py (check_deterministic, answer_digest) and service_by_design.json. The catalogue entry of `deterministic` is in checks.json; the twins' own checks are those of their sources' chapters (P, R, L, M, T, Q), catalogued there and in checks-QCND.json; the by-design cases it names: resolve.job_path (cases.json), pattern.not_expressible.max_steps (cases-QCND.json).

_assumes._note: The literal numbers this file's prose may carry, each with its source: constants of the SPEC, of the manifest (repeats, picks), of the service's table or of the harness, never a figure of a run (those are placeholders the generator fills). tests/test_doc.py fails on a number the prose carries that is listed neither here nor as a placeholder; add a constant here with its source, never a run's figure.

intro: The SPECs promise that the same request answers the same: a traversal is deterministic provided no time budget tripped (SPEC-labeled-traversal-core section 6.8), a pattern search's answer repeats unless the entry states `determinism` `time_limited` (SPEC-pattern-search section 7.9), and a 503 deadline depends on the machine. Chapter D takes fast scenarios of the other chapters and runs each three times on every arm: P (six), R (four), L and M (three each), T and Q (two each), plus one complete planted search at `max_mismatches` 2, the forward planted window with the lowest chance estimate, so that it completes without a budget stop. The picks leave out everything whose answer may depend on what ran before it or on the clock: refusals, machine-dependent and retention-dependent scenarios, relation twins, split cases, warm-ups, run-unique attempt ids, raw bodies and custom headers, and any status expectation other than a 200.

A twin keeps its source's request and property checks (its status expectation replaced by a 200) and adds `deterministic`: the answer's digest, the sha256 of the canonical JSON of the normalised answer without its headers and timing keys, must equal the digests of the earlier repeats on the same arm that no time budget limited; the first repeat has nothing to compare and rests on the other checks, a time-limited repeat reads inconclusive unless its stated limitation cannot have happened (appendix A). So every twin shows two things per arm: the digests equal across the repeats (the pairs tables mark each row = or not), and the source's property passing three times. The record key of each source is in its own chapter.

Via MCP each repeat is a new search or job: the MCP runner names an idempotency key per execution, so the service's reuse of a running or recent identical search (`service.pattern_repeat_reuses_search`, appendix B) does not apply, and a resolve is a new job on the anonymous path (`resolve.job_path`, `service.resolve_repeat`). The tool's answer carries the fields the service exposes, so a source check that reads a field the service drops is not exposed on that arm (v5 marks these per check), and the MCP digests compare the tool's answers with one another, never with the direct arms' documents. A source naming a field the tool cannot send (`max_steps`: `pattern.not_expressible.max_steps`) is not exercised there.

D.title: determinism
D.prose: One family, six units by the source's chapter. Each twin's three repeats on an arm must answer the same digest, and the source's own checks must pass on each: a 12-mer counted in suffix scope, a 25-mer's contexts at their offsets, a window placed under a predicate, the first 20 bases of lambda in suffix scope, a 25-mer with three IUPAC codes and a random 31-mer absent (D-P); a window resolved under its column at one k-mer, 100 bp and 2,000 bp, and the junction of two records (D-R); a 32 bp path search, a 40 bp record-verified path and a supported path at the label_intersection level (D-L); a planted search out of reach (two substitutions at `max_mismatches` 1), an IUPAC search with one substitution, a `max_steps` stop in partial with its cut, and the complete planted search at `max_mismatches` 2 (D-M); a 31 bp seed walked right under its header and a seed with its derived carrier set (D-T); `any(A)` selecting the record's contexts and the `-` source contexts selected under context strands (D-Q). D.claim: the same request answers the same digest three times on every arm that exercised it, and its source's property holds each time on the direct arms

units.D-P: Three repeats of a chapter P source (a 12-mer counted in suffix scope, a 25-mer's contexts, a window placed under a predicate, a suffix-scope search, three IUPAC codes, a random 31-mer absent) answer the same digest on every arm (deterministic), the source's own checks passing each time.

units.D-L: Three repeats of a chapter L source (a 32 bp path search, a 40 bp record-verified path, a supported path at label_intersection) answer the same digest on every arm (deterministic), the source's own checks passing each time.
units.D-M: Three repeats of a chapter M source (a planted search out of reach at max_mismatches 1, an IUPAC search with one substitution, a max_steps stop in partial, a complete planted search at max_mismatches 2) answer the same digest on every arm (deterministic), the source's own checks passing each time.
units.D-T: Three repeats of a chapter T source (a 31 bp seed walked under its header, a seed with its derived carrier set) answer the same digest on every arm (deterministic), the source's own checks passing each time.
